description: A horizontal beam along its centre line from start to end (plan mm), default 400 wide × 600 deep with its top just under the floor above (the level's floor-to-floor height − 200). top = height of its top above the level floor, mm. For a transfer beam carrying apartment walls over a car park, make it deeper (e.g. 600 × 1200) and run it along the walls above. Beams above the plan cut are drawn dashed in plans; cut solid in sections.

end.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

start.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level
